## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 184 captures during January 2024. This activity provides the monthly operational total for the site and supports review of image capture and grading performance. The reported volume should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable_rate was 1.6. This measure should be monitored as part of routine quality assurance. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed through the usual operational process.

## Grading

A total of 47 captures were referable. The median lag was 5. This result should be considered with the ungradable total and the overall capture activity when reviewing service performance for January 2024. Together, these measures provide a concise view of the work completed at Central Eye Clinic during the reporting month.
